subject: general
question: Which off the following is the roadmap to achieve development and child protection priorities aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mission Vatsalya**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mission Vatsalya Monitoring System **is a roadmap to achieve child protection and development priorities that align with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 
 
• The **Mission Vatsalya roadmap aims to protect children at the community and family level.**
 
• **It helps families and communities identify risks and vulnerabilities that affect children.**
 
• **It also helps create and promote preventive measures** to protect children from abuse, risk, and vulnerability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sustainable Development Goals (SDG)15 seeks to ‘Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt and reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss.
 
• The United Nations General Assembly adopted the "2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development" in 2015, with global goals.
 
• The 193 members of GA adopted the framework "Transforming our world: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development" with 17 goals & 169 targets.
